topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
response: The suppression of 19th harmonics by the filter can improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations. The nonlinear distortions caused by high-power amplifiers (HPAs) operated near saturation point lead to intermodulation products (IMDs) and adjacent channel interference (ACI). Filter design can mitigate these effects, but specific data on 19th harmonic suppression is not provided in the context.
